mock_data.title: A Day of Misfortunes
mock_data.passage:
3/2/02

Dear Jenny,

It was great to get your letter. You sound as if you're really enjoying college and I can't wait to join you. I'm beginning to wish that I had turned a deaf ear to my dad's suggestion that I spend a year getting some work experience before going to college.

I've just got back from work and I've had a really bad hair day. For starters, I got up late. I must have switched off my alarm clock when it went off at 7! I didn't wake up till an hour later. Panic stations! Instead of having a leisurely bath, washing my hair, choosing my clothes carefully and having a nourishing breakfast, I climbed into yesterday's clothes, grabbed a couple of biscuits and headed for the door.

I could still have caught a bus that would get me to work on time, but as luck would have it, I saw old Mrs Smart next door struggling to put her rubbish bin out on the street. I stopped to help her and got to the bus stop just as the bus had left it. There was no possibility of taking a taxi because I'm on my beam ends until pay day next week. I seriously thought of calling the office to say I was sick, but I decided to go in and face the music.

When I got to the office, I waited until I thought the coast was clear and hurried past reception without being seen by any of the bosses. 'Hurray!' I said to myself, 'I've got away with it!' I spoke too soon. When I got to my desk, there was my supervisor, Mrs Mason. 'At long last!' she said sarcastically, 'you've decided to favour us with your presence. My office now!'

By this time I had a very bad headache and was badly in need of a cup of coffee. Instead, I had to listen while Mrs Mason read me the riot act. From what she said I'm completely useless and totally unreliable. It didn't do much for my morale! The thing is it was so unfair. I work hard for very little money and I'm hardly ever late. Naturally, I didn't say this to Mrs Smart!

Sorry this is such a moaning letter, but I badly need somebody to grumble to.

I'll write a more cheerful one soon.

Love
Linda

Dear Jenny,

It was great to get your letter. It sounds like you are really enjoying college, and I can't wait to join you. I'm starting to think I should have ignored my dad's idea about working for a year before college.

I just got back from work, and I had a really bad day. To start with, I woke up late. I must have turned off my alarm when it rang at 7! I didn't wake up until an hour later. I was panicking! Instead of having a nice bath, washing my hair, choosing my clothes, and eating a good breakfast, I put on yesterday's clothes, grabbed some biscuits, and left.

I could still have caught a bus that would get me to work on time, but as luck would have it, I saw Mrs. Smart next door having trouble putting her bin outside. I stopped to help her and got to the bus stop just as the bus was leaving. I couldn't take a taxi because I have no money left until I get paid next week. I thought about calling work to say I was sick, but I decided to go in and face the problem.

When I got to the office, I waited until I thought no one was watching and hurried past reception so the bosses wouldn't see me. 'Yes!' I thought, 'I did it!' I was wrong. When I got to my desk, my supervisor, Mrs. Mason, was there. 'Finally!' she said in an angry way, 'you've decided to come to work. Come to my office now!'

By then, I had a bad headache and really needed coffee. But instead, I had to listen while Mrs. Mason told me off. She said I was completely useless and not reliable at all. It made me feel terrible! It was so unfair because I work hard for little money, and I'm almost never late. Of course, I didn't say this to Mrs. Mason!

Sorry this is such a complaining letter, but I really need someone to complain to.

I'll write a happier one soon.

Love,

Linda

Instead of enjoying a relaxing bath, washing my hair, carefully choosing my outfit, and having a proper breakfast, I threw on yesterday's clothes, grabbed a couple of biscuits, and rushed out the door.

I stopped to give her a hand, and arrived at the bus stop just as the bus was pulling away. There was no chance of getting a taxi because I'm completely broke until payday next week. I seriously considered calling in sick, but I decided to go in and face the consequences.

But I spoke too soon. When I got to my desk, there was my supervisor, Mrs. Mason. 'About time!' she said frostily, 'you decided to join us. My office, now!'

By this point, I had a terrible headache and desperately needed a cup of coffee. Instead, I had to sit and listen while Mrs. Mason gave me a telling-off. According to her, I'm completely incompetent and totally unreliable. It really dampened my spirits! The thing is, it was so unfair. I work hard for very little money, and I'm hardly ever late. Naturally, I didn't say any of this to Mrs. Mason!

Sorry this is such a negative letter, but I really needed someone to vent to.

I'll write a more cheerful one soon.

Love,

Linda
mock_data.passageC1:
Dear Jenny,

Hearing from you was such a tonic. It sounds like you're absolutely thriving at university, and the anticipation of joining you is really building. I'm starting to entertain doubts about whether I should have taken my father's advice to gain work experience before enrolling. Perhaps I should have just trusted my instincts.

I've just returned from what can only be described as a truly catastrophic day at work. To compound matters, it all began with a monumental oversleep. I must have inadvertently silenced my alarm when it went off at 7 a.m., because I didn't surface until a full hour later. Cue absolute pandemonium! The leisurely bath, the careful wardrobe selection, the nourishing breakfast – all consigned to the dustbin. Instead, I threw on yesterday's attire, wolfed down a couple of biscuits, and bolted out the door.

Had circumstances been more favourable, I might still have caught a bus that would have delivered me to work punctually. However, as fate would have it, I encountered old Mrs. Smart, my neighbour, struggling valiantly to manoeuvre her refuse bin onto the pavement. I paused to assist her, only to arrive at the bus stop just as my designated bus was pulling away. A taxi was out of the question, given my precarious financial situation until payday next week. I briefly considered feigning illness and calling in sick, but ultimately decided to bite the bullet and face the music.

Upon reaching the office, I waited for what I perceived to be an opportune moment, then slipped past reception, attempting to avoid detection by any senior management. 'Success!' I thought to myself, prematurely. My sense of triumph was short-lived. Upon arriving at my desk, I was confronted by my supervisor, Mrs. Mason. 'At long last!' she exclaimed, with a palpable tone of sarcasm, 'you've decided to grace us with your presence. My office, immediately!'

By this juncture, I was battling a severe headache and desperately craving a cup of coffee. Instead, I was subjected to a lengthy and unflattering assessment from Mrs. Mason, during which she essentially painted me as completely incompetent and utterly unreliable. It did little for my dwindling morale! The frustrating aspect is the sheer injustice of it all. I work diligently for a pittance and I am rarely tardy. Naturally, I refrained from voicing these sentiments to Mrs. Mason!

Apologies for the relentlessly negative tone of this missive, but I was in dire need of someone to vent my spleen to.

I promise to pen a more cheerful letter in the near future.

Love,

Linda

mock_data.translation:
3/2/02

Hurmatli Jenni,

Xatingni olganim ajoyib edi. Sen kollejdan haqiqatan ham zavqlanayotganga o'xshaysan va men senga qo'shilishni kuta olmayman. Men otamning bir yil ish tajribasini olishni taklif qilganiga quloq solmaganimni xohlayapman.

Men hozirgina ishdan qaytdim va haqiqatan ham yomon kun o'tkazdim. Birinchidan, men kech turdim. Ehtimol soat 7 da budilnik chalinganda uni o'chirib qo'ygan bo'lsam kerak! Men bir soat keyin uyg'ondim. Vahima boshlandi! Sokin cho'milish, sochimni yuvish, kiyimlarimni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlash va to'yimli nonushta qilish o'rniga, men kechagi kiyimlarimni kiyib, bir nechta pechene oldim va eshik tomon yo'l oldim.

Men hali ham ishga o'z vaqtida yetkazib beradigan avtobusni ushlay olardim, ammo omad teskari bo'ldi, men qo'shni kampir Smart xonimni axlat qutisini ko'chaga chiqarishga urinib turganini ko'rdim. Men unga yordam berish uchun to'xtadim va avtobus bekatiga avtobus ketganidan keyin yetib bordim. Taksi olish imkoniyati yo'q edi, chunki men keyingi haftagacha pulsizman. Men kasalligimni aytib ofisga qo'ng'iroq qilishni jiddiy o'yladim, ammo borishga va oqibatga duch kelishga qaror qildim.

Ofisga yetganimda, xavf yo'q deb o'ylaguncha kutdim va hech bir rahbar ko'rmasdek qabulxonadan shoshildim. "Yuurreyy!" dedim o'zimga, "Men qutuldim!" Men juda erta gapirdim. Stolimga kelganimda, mening nazoratchi xonim Meyson turardi. "Nihoyat!" dedi u kinoyali ohangda, "sen bizga o'z borligingni ko'rsatishga qaror qilding. Mening ofisimga hozir!"

Bu vaqtga kelib mening boshim juda og'riyotgan edi va kofe juda kerak edi. Buning o'rniga, men xonim Meyson menga qattiq tanbeh berganini tingladim. Uning aytganiga ko'ra, men mutlaqo foydasizman va mutlaqo ishonchsizman. Bu mening ruhumni ko'tarish uchun ko'p narsa qilmadi! Gap shundaki, bu juda adolatsiz edi. Men juda oz pul uchun qattiq ishlayapman va deyarli hech qachon kechikmayman. Tabiiy, men buni xonim Smartga aytmadim!

Kechirasiz, bu shunday nola xat, ammo menga norozi bo'ladigan odam juda kerak.

Tez orada yanada quvnoqroq xat yozaman.

Muhabbat bilan
Linda

mock_data.translationB1:
Aziz Jenni,

Xatingni olganimdan xursand bo'ldim. Kollejda juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazayotganingga o'xshaydi va men ham senga qo'shilishni juda xohlayman. Otamning kollejdan oldin bir yil ishlash haqidagi fikriga e'tibor bermasligim kerak edi, deb o'ylay boshladim.

Men hozirgina ishdan qaytdim va kunim juda yomon o'tdi. Eng avvalo, men kech uyg'onib qoldim. Soat 7 da jiringlaganda signalni o'chirib qo'ygan bo'lsam kerak! Bir soatdan keyin uyg'ondim. Men vahimaga tushdim! Chiroyli vanna qabul qilish, sochimni yuvish, kiyimlarimni tanlash va yaxshi nonushta qilish o'rniga, kechagi kiyimimni kiydim, bir nechta pechene oldim va ketdim.

Men hali ham ishga o'z vaqtida yetib boradigan avtobusga ulgurishim mumkin edi, lekin omadga qarshi, qo'shnimiz Mrs. Smart axlat qutisini tashqariga chiqarishda qiynalayotganini ko'rib qoldim. Unga yordam berish uchun to'xtadim va avtobus bekatiga avtobus ketayotgan paytda yetib keldim. Taksi ololmadim, chunki keyingi haftada oylik olgunimcha pulim qolmadi. Ishga qo'ng'iroq qilib, kasalman deb aytishni o'yladim, lekin ishga borib, muammoga yuzma-yuz kelishga qaror qildim.

Ofisga yetib kelganimda, hech kim qaramayapti deb o'ylaguncha kutdim va xo'jayinlar ko'rmasligi uchun resepshndan shoshib o'tib ketdim. "Ha!" deb o'yladim, "buni uddaladim!" Men yanglishdim. Mening stolimga yetib kelganimda, mening rahbarim, Mrs. Mason, u yerda edi. "Nihoyat!" dedi u g'azab bilan, "ishga kelishga qaror qilding. Hozir mening xonamga kel!"

O'shanda boshim qattiq og'riyotgan edi va menga haqiqatan ham qahva kerak edi. Ammo buning o'rniga, Mrs. Mason menga tanbeh berganini eshitishim kerak edi. U meni butunlay foydasiz va umuman ishonchsiz ekanligimni aytdi. Bu meni dahshatli his qildirdi! Bu juda adolatsiz edi, chunki men kam pulga qattiq ishlayman va deyarli hech qachon kechikmayman. Albatta, men buni Mrs. Masonga aytmadim!

Kechirasiz, bu juda noligan xat, lekin menga haqiqatan ham arzimni doston qiladigan odam kerak.

Tez orada xursandchilikka to'la xat yozaman.

Muhabbat bilan,

Linda

Aziz Jenny,

Sizdan xabar olish juda ham quvonchli bo'ldi. Universitetda a'lo darajada o'qiyotganingizni eshitib, sizga qo'shilish istagim yanada kuchaydi. Men o'qishga kirishdan oldin otamning ish tajribasini orttirish haqidagi maslahatiga quloq solganimga shubha qilayapman. Balki, shunchaki o'z instinktlarimga ishonishim kerak edi.

Men hozirgina ishxonadagi haqiqatan ham fojiali kunimdan qaytdim. Vaziyatni yanada og'irlashtirgan omil shundaki, hammasi dahshatli uxlab qolish bilan boshlandi. Soat 7:00 da signal jiringlaganda men uni beixtiyor o'chirib qo'ygan bo'lsam kerak, chunki men bir soatdan keyin uyg'ondim. Oqibatda to'liq tartibsizlik! Sekin hammom, ehtiyotkorlik bilan kiyim tanlash, to'yimli nonushta – bularning hammasi chiqindiga uloqtirildi. Buning o'rniga, men kechagi kiyimimni kiyib, bir-ikki pechene yulib oldim va eshikdan otilib chiqdim.

Agar vaziyat yaxshiroq bo'lganida, men ishga o'z vaqtida yetib borishimga imkon beradigan avtobusga chiqishim mumkin edi. Ammo, taqdir taqozosi bilan, men qo'shnim, keksa xonim Smartni chiqindi qutisini yo'lakka olib chiqishga astoydil urinayotganini ko'rib qoldim. Unga yordam berish uchun to'xtadim va men mo'ljallangan avtobus uzoqlashayotgan paytda avtobus bekatiga yetib keldim. Keyingi haftagacha moliyaviy ahvolim og'ir ekanligini hisobga olsak, taksi haqida o'ylash ham mumkin emasdi. Men qisqacha kasal bo'lib qoldim va ishga qo'ng'iroq qilishni o'yladim, lekin oxir-oqibat qiyinchilikka bardosh berishga va oqibatlarga tayyor bo'lishga qaror qildim.

Ofisga yetib kelganimdan so'ng, men qulay deb hisoblagan vaqtni kutdim, keyin har qanday yuqori lavozimli rahbarlar tomonidan sezilib qolmaslik uchun sezdirmasdan o'tib ketdim. "Omad!" deb o'yladim o'zimga, erta xursand bo'lib. Mening g'alaba hissi qisqa muddatli bo'ldi. Stolimga yetib kelganimda, meni rahbarim, xonim Meyson kutib oldi. U sezilarli darajada kinoya bilan: "Nihoyat!" dedi, "bizni o'z tashrifingiz bilan sharaflashga qaror qildingizmi? Mening xonamga, darhol!"

Bu vaqtga kelib, men kuchli bosh og'rig'i bilan kurashayotgan edim va qattiq qahva ichishni xohlardim. Buning o'rniga, men xonim Meysondan uzoq va yoqimsiz bahoga duchor bo'ldim, u aslida meni butunlay layoqatsiz va mutlaqo ishonchsiz deb ta'rifladi. Bu mening pasayib borayotgan kayfiyatimga hech qanday foyda keltirmadi! Achinarlisi, bularning barchasi qanchalik adolatsiz ekanligidir. Men arzimagan pulga astoydil ishlayman va kamdan-kam hollarda kechikaman. Tabiiyki, men bu fikrlarni xonim Meysonga aytmadim!

Ushbu xatning tinimsiz salbiy ohangi uchun uzr so'rayman, lekin menga ichimdagi g'azabni to'kishga muhtoj bo'lgan odam kerak edi.

Yaqin kelajakda yanada xursandchilikka to'la xat yozishga va'da beraman.

Sevgi bilan,

Linda
